faq.q: How much does The Bronx Defenders charge?
faq.a: The Bronx Defenders publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does The Bronx Defenders offer a free consultation?
faq.a: The Bronx Defenders does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does The Bronx Defenders have offices?
faq.a: The Bronx Defenders publishes one office, in Bronx. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Bronx Defenders?
faq.a: The Bronx Defenders names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from.
